The '''Beris system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Fei Hu sector/Legends|Fei Hu sector]], which was within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beris]].
